content.comment_body: Any assistance would be appreciated! I've tried everything to get the HMI to control an output on the [product_name] controller but it isn't working. I created a program in [product_name]_software, made a screen in [product_name]_engineering_tool, linked the devices there, but the screen can't communicate with the [product_name] controller.
Could you upload your [product_name]_engineering_tool project and [product_name]_software program as a zip file to the forum?

I’m sorry, but I can't find any connection between your parameter-VM assignment and your settings in the [product_name] program and the [product_name]_engineering_tool project. There's already a conflict: you're declaring VW0 and using bits from VW0 for digital operations at the same time, which won't work. Without knowing your specific requirements, I can't provide further help.
I've attempted multiple methods to resolve the issue—what you reviewed was just my most recent try. In that file, I was attempting to display the digital output of the threshold trigger on the HMI.
Sorry, but your current declarations do not make sense, not in the [product_name] file nor in [product_name]_engineering_tool. Please specify exactly what you want transferred to the HMI.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face confusion and frustration when setting up communication between [product_name] controllers and HMI devices using [product_name]_software and [product_name]_engineering_tool. The main challenges involve parameter mapping and functional links within the configuration tools. Feedback points to vague or insufficient guidance and a lack of clear error messages regarding conflicting parameter assignments.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward and reliable configuration process that links the [product_name] controller with the HMI, so the HMI can correctly display and control outputs. They also anticipate clear and helpful feedback, along with guided setup steps, especially when configuration errors occur.
